scope.automated: Entire repository pytest suite; compileall for scripts and package; AST scan of 147 Python files for duplicate definitions; local-only-file guard; byte-for-byte reproduction of CR9114 mapping artifacts.
scope.manual: Structure declaration and parsing, raw author identifiers, source pinning, correspondence and site-order contracts, packing and portable artifact validation, report/source verification, policy binding, mapping-audit provenance, and README consistency. This is not an assertion that every repository path is bug-free.

fixed_findings.problem: PDB/mmCIF preparation discarded occupancy information, so zero-occupancy coordinates could be accepted as usable geometry. The mapping audit also checked atom presence without checking occupancy.
fixed_findings.fix: Read occupancy explicitly, require the mmCIF field, reject unresolved values on selected chains, and require finite occupancy in (0, 1]. Apply the same numeric check in the mapping audit.
fixed_findings.regression_coverage: PDB and mmCIF zero, negative, greater-than-one, and nonfinite occupancy; missing mmCIF occupancy; mapping-audit invalid occupancy.

fixed_findings.problem: Only N/CA/C coordinates were checked for finiteness, despite the declared rejection rule applying to every selected-chain atom. A discarded O/side-chain coordinate could be invalid without a refusal.
fixed_findings.fix: Validate all selected atom coordinates before extracting the backbone; reject unresolved mmCIF coordinates and validate coordinate values in the mapping audit.
fixed_findings.regression_coverage: Nonfinite non-backbone atom in PDB and mmCIF; missing/nonfinite coordinate in the mapping audit.

documentation_corrections: README now identifies the selected CR9114/H1 ESM-IF1 experiment and labels the HCDR3 architecture as the broader research direction.
Removed contradictory assertions that this checkout has no corpus and no recorded hardware measurements.
Replaced an unsupported universal torch-scatter wheel claim with the actual Windows dependency rationale.
